fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck gate identified. PFG Milton's is a multi-building campus set back behind a treeline buffer from the public road (Mundy Mill Rd / Old Oakwood Rd). Internal access roads connect the buildings; Street View (Apr 2022) shows Google's car drove onto the interior truck-yard pavement and dock face, indicating an open/uncontrolled entrance. A chain-link fence separates an employee parking lot from the truck yard but there is no barrier arm or checkpoint at the property entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible at any entrance to the campus.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Multiple dock faces across the campus buildings — trailers backed in onto dock aprons at the main DC (z18/z19 imagery), plus additional doors on the meat-cutting / freezer / fleet buildings. Aggregate ~60 across the campus; band 50+. Low-confidence count given multiple building faces.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Dedicated trailer drop yard on the NE side of the campus with dense rows of drop trailers (55+ visible). Band 50+.
fieldNotes.dropYard: True — a dedicated trailer-storage lot occupies the NE portion of the campus.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: True — PFG Milton's is a campus of multiple large buildings. Per web research the campus includes the original broadline DC plus a 174,000 sq ft expansion building (on 43 adjacent acres) housing freezer, meat-cutting operation, and fleet operations.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Likely — the multi-building campus (broadline DC + separate freezer/meat-cutting building) implies physically separate dock clusters on different buildings. Medium-confidence; flagged.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: Estimated 2 — the campus has more than one access driveway off the surrounding roads. Low-confidence.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide internal paved truck courts between the campus buildings provide interior holding/queue room.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Oakwood GA is a small town in Hall County on the exurban fringe of metro Atlanta along I-985 — small-town industrial setting, not dense metro fabric. Classified Rural per the rubric tie-break.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale visible in overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the campus.
fieldNotes._locationNote: A warehouserating.com listing places 3501 Old Oakwood Rd at 34.238252,-83.875948, but Street View at that point shows a small retail strip, not a DC. The actual PFG Milton's campus is ~290 m ESE at the locked coordinate, confirmed by Street View dock-face imagery of trailers backed into a multi-temp food DC.
